ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "Race, Ethnicity and the Politics of Identity." Meets with SOC 596. This course explores the shifting terrain of racial identities in the US. We will explore the history of "race" and "ethnicity," the construction of "panethnic" identities, and contemporary debates surrounding racial self-definition. Readings will focus on the politics of enumeration, including how racial identity is measured, and the problems inherent in collecting racial demographic data. Additional emphasis will be placed on immigrant identities, assimilation/acculturation, and ethnic resilience in the second generation and beyond.
